# python-error-handling

Use when the user asks for python error handling work.

## Workflow
1. Identify expected versus unexpected exceptions.
2. Catch narrowly, preserve context with exception chaining, and avoid swallowing failures.
3. Add useful safe logs without secrets.
4. Define retries, timeouts and idempotency where applicable.
5. Test failure conditions.

## Verification
State which checks were executed, what passed, and what could not be verified. Favor existing project conventions. Use local resources; do not require network access merely to read this skill.
